name: Chest Pain Emergency
guidance_text: 🚨 Call emergency services immediately. Do not drive yourself. Sit upright and stay calm while waiting for help.

name: Severe Breathing
guidance_text: 🚨 Severe breathing difficulty requires immediate care. Call emergency services now. Use inhaler if prescribed.

name: High Fever with Confusion
guidance_text: 🚨 High fever with confusion is serious. Call emergency services. Cool the person with wet cloths while waiting.

name: Vomiting Blood
guidance_text: 🚨 Vomiting blood requires immediate hospital care. Do not eat or drink. Call emergency services.

name: Severe Abdominal Pain
guidance_text: See a doctor within 24 hours. Severe stomach pain can indicate serious conditions. Avoid eating until evaluated.

name: Persistent Fever
guidance_text: Fever lasting more than 3 days needs medical evaluation. Stay hydrated and rest. See doctor tomorrow.

name: Chest Discomfort
guidance_text: Chest symptoms should be evaluated by a doctor within 24 hours. Avoid strenuous activity until seen.

name: Breathing Difficulty
guidance_text: Difficulty breathing needs prompt medical attention. If worsening, go to emergency immediately.

name: Severe Headache
guidance_text: Severe or sudden headaches require medical evaluation. Rest in quiet dark room until seen.

name: Joint Pain with Swelling
guidance_text: Joint pain with swelling suggests inflammation. Schedule doctor appointment within 2-3 days. Rest the affected joint.

name: Fever with Body Pain
guidance_text: Likely viral infection. Rest, fluids, paracetamol. See doctor if no improvement in 3 days.

name: Digestive Issues
guidance_text: Stomach symptoms usually resolve in 24-48 hours. Stay hydrated. See doctor if persists beyond 2 days.

name: Respiratory Symptoms
guidance_text: Cold/flu symptoms. Rest, fluids, steam inhalation. See doctor if fever develops or symptoms worsen.

name: Skin Rash
guidance_text: Monitor rash for spreading or itching. Avoid scratching. See doctor if worsens or accompanied by fever.

name: General Fatigue
guidance_text: Fatigue often improves with rest. Ensure 8 hours sleep, hydration, and balanced meals.

name: Mild Headache
guidance_text: Rest in quiet room, drink water, take paracetamol if needed. See doctor if frequent or severe.

name: Back Pain
guidance_text: Back pain usually improves with rest and gentle stretching. Use warm compress. Avoid heavy lifting.

name: Cold Symptoms
guidance_text: Common cold resolves in 7-10 days. Rest, fluids, vitamin C. No antibiotics needed.
